Plot species discovery and synonymy over time

Source: R/discoveryGraph.R
discoveryGraph.Rd

Produces a graphic with two panels: the number of species described in each period of time, and the number of synonyms published in each period. A species is counted in the year of its oldest homotypic name (its basionym), i.e. the year it was discovered, not the year of its current name. While accGraph shows the cumulative discovery of species, this graphic shows when taxonomic work, i.e. new species and renaming, was most intense.

Usage

discoveryGraph(inputdf = NULL,
               bin = 10,
               verbose = TRUE,
               save = FALSE,
               dpi = 600,
               dir = "results_discoveryGraph",
               filename = "discovery_graph",
               format = "jpg")

Arguments

inputdf

A data frame generated with powoSpecies using synonyms = TRUE.

bin

Number of years in each bar. The default is 10 (decades).

verbose

Logical, if FALSE, a message showing each step will not be printed in the console.

save

Logical, if TRUE, the graphic will be saved on disk.

dpi

One number in the range of 72-4000 referring to the image resolution in dots per inch. The default is 600.

dir

Pathway to the computer's directory, where the graphic will be saved provided that the argument save is TRUE. The default is to create a directory named results_discoveryGraph and the graphic will be saved within a subfolder named after the current date.

filename

Name of the output file. The default is discovery_graph.

format

The file format of the graphic: "jpg" (default), "pdf", "png" or "tiff".

Value

A ggplot object, whose data has the number of names (names) in each period (period) for each panel (what).

See also

powoSpecies

accGraph

Author

Debora Zuanny & Domingos Cardoso

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(expowo)

fab <- powoSpecies("Fabaceae", synonyms = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

discoveryGraph(fab,
               save = TRUE,
               dir = "results_discoveryGraph",
               filename = "Fabaceae_discovery")
} # }
